newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes little changed.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes little changed.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed little changed in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 596.31 from 596.92 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 2.67 million dinars against 218,670 dinars.
BTEI bank was up 0.38 dinar to 22.88 dinars. BDET bank was down 0.43 dinar to 13.950 dinars.
Retail stores MONOPRIX was down 0.9 dinar to 36.1 dinars.
